title: Bringing Directed Energy Weapons Into Focus: Integrating Emerging Capabilities Into NATO Air Defence
summary_en: This article examines the potential contribution of Directed Energy Weapons to NATO air defence.
title_cn: Bringing Directed Energy Weapons Into Focus: Integrating Emerging Capabilities Into NATO Air Defence

title: Private Equity Ownership and Artificial Intelligence Adoption by Hospitals in the United States
summary_en: We examined the association between private equity hospital ownership and the likelihood of artificial intelligence technology adoption.
title_cn: Private Equity Ownership and Artificial Intelligence Adoption by Hospitals in the United States

title: Generative Artificial Intelligence Use and Adolescent Mental Health
summary_en: This paper synthesizes recent literature on the relationships between GenAI use and adolescents’ mental health, with particular attention to problematic use and psychiatric vulnerabilities.
title_cn: Generative Artificial Intelligence Use and Adolescent Mental Health

title: From Policy to Practice: How State Policies Relate to Public Pre-K Teachers’ Curriculum Use
summary_en: We investigated the role that state policies related to preschool curriculum play in public school pre-K teachers’ reported curricula use across the United States.
title_cn: From Policy to Practice: How State Policies Relate to Public Pre-K Teachers’ Curriculum Use
